statement: ∀ (bar : Reduction.loc p →+* K), letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := bar.toAlgebra; ∀ (Phi : Reduction.VK K M ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M)) (f : Module.End ℤ M) (F : Module.End ℂ V), (∀ m : M, (f m : V) = F m) → Phi.toLinearMap.comp (f.baseChange K) = ((f.baseChange (Reduction.loc p)).baseChange K).comp Phi.toLinearMap → ∀ (u w : Reduction.MR p M) (s : Reduction.loc p), F (Reduction.iota p M u) = (algebraMap (Reduction.loc p) ℂ s) • Reduction.iota p M w → f.baseChange K (Phi.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u)) = bar s • Phi.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] w)
proof:
intro bar
letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := bar.toAlgebra
intro Phi f F hf hPhi u w s he
apply yui_aux_0003 p l K V act x y h v0 M h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_H005 h_T002 h_T004 h_T007 h_T008 bar Phi f hPhi u w s
apply h_T004.1.2.2.2.1
rw [map_smul, yui_aux_0002 p l K V act x y h v0 M h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_H005 h_T002 h_T004 h_T007 h_T008 f F hf]
exact he

checked : ∀ (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type u_2) [fieldK : Field K] (V : Type u_1) [addV : AddCommGroup V]
  [modV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (act : ↥Reduction.SL →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ End ℂ V) (x y h : ↥Reduction.SL) (v0 : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p →
    CharP K p →
      0 ≤ l ∧ l < ↑p →
        Reduction.chevalley x y h →
          Reduction.basisFacts l (act x) (act y) (act h) v0 →
            Reduction.localizationFacts p l (act x) (act y) (act h) v0 M →
              Reduction.commonFacts p l (act y) v0 M →
                Reduction.scalarFacts p K M →
                  ∀ (bar : ↥(Reduction.loc p) →+* K)
                    (Phi : Reduction.VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[↥(Reduction.loc p)] Reduction.MR p M) (f : End ℤ ↥M)
                    (F : End ℂ V),
                    (∀ (m : ↥M), ↑(f m) = F ↑m) →
                      ↑Phi ∘ₗ LinearMap.baseChange K f =
                          LinearMap.baseChange K (LinearMap.baseChange (↥(Reduction.loc p)) f) ∘ₗ ↑Phi →
                        ∀ (u w : Reduction.MR p M) (s : ↥(Reduction.loc p)),
                          F ((Reduction.iota p M) u) = (algebraMap ↥(Reduction.loc p) ℂ) s • (Reduction.iota p M) w →
                            (LinearMap.baseChange K f) (Phi.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[↥(Reduction.loc p)] u)) =
                              bar s • Phi.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[↥(Reduction.loc p)] w)
